goal: Compare normalized probabilistic marginalization over unknown insertions against existing max-path monotone alignment

training.model: existing unsupervised public-stream token permutation; no reward or privileged mapping

observation_family: unaligned_stream.stream; preserve original generator, insert 2..4 unmarked extra symbols in each stream

model_design.score: log average likelihood ratio over every monotone 8-pair correspondence; sum-product DP with normalized alignment count; expose posterior uncertainty only as diagnostic

baselines: old unsupervised max-path alignment with same fitted token permutation
reward-trained unaligned scorer from same training episodes
privileged hidden-token cipher scored by new likelihood
primary: number of successful occluded-navigation tasks out of 40 per seed
secondary: posterior separation of first and second choice
deterministic numerical agreement with brute-force enumeration
input validation, checkpoint integrity and no evaluation updates
restrictions: Do not change old tests or benchmarks
No true cipher, position, or correct cue in online inference
Any new hyperparameter must be frozen here before test eval, do not tune after result
Not an independent blind holdout; prior seeds examined
Model may be pure unsupervised postselector and should not be described as learned temporal structure
No default promotion on losses/ties, no privileges or AthenZ/Synveil runtime dependencies
